behavior: AC1: a scoped, negated-interface, multiport, range or comment-qualified iptables ACCEPT for the port reads as present
AC2: with no covering rule setup appends once, a second run is ok, and a ts-input jump changes nothing
AC3: another port, udp, --sport, negated ports, non-ACCEPT targets, jumps, comments and rules without a destination port never count
AC4: a ufw allow with no destination port covers the port; proto udp, app profiles and source-port-only rules do not
AC5: the iptables read is iptables -S INPUT through Output; -A is the only mutation; a non-zero -S is unverified or failed
